mapper.sql: id, project_id, question, question_vector, answer, hit_refs, feedback, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qa_history (project_id, question, question_vector, answer, hit_refs, feedback, create_time) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{question}, #{questionVector}, #{answer}, #{hitRefs}, #{feedback}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM qa_history WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE qa_history SET feedback = #{feedback} WHERE id = #{id}
